cause_quote: The sidebar rebuild added SidebarCollapsibleHeader with `.heightIn(min = 44.dp)` and the Pages pencil as `IconButton(... modifier = Modifier.size(44.dp).testTag("sidebar-pages-menu"))`, sizes below Compose's 48dp touch target so the automatic expansion overlaps the neighboring control.
user_saw: On Android, tapping near the edge of the Pages pencil or a sidebar section header toggled the neighboring control, for example collapsing Pages instead of opening the pencil menu.
summary: Raises the Android sidebar collapsible header minimum height and the Pages pencil button from 44dp to 48dp so edge taps reach the intended control, with a coordinate regression test.
reasoning: GraphQL blame at the fix parent attributes both changed lines to 5fa8356 (#134939), and that commit's diff shows it adding SidebarCollapsibleHeader and the sidebar-pages-menu IconButton with the 44dp sizes (it even replaced older 48dp minimums), so the defect shipped with the introducing code. Medium because I did not verify that the adjacency causing touch-target overlap existed exactly as at the fix parent when 5fa8356 landed.
